```json
  {"metric": "iout_err_pct", "op": "<=", "value": 2.0},
  {"metric": "rout", "op": ">=", "value": 190000},
  {"metric": "v_compliance", "op": "<=", "value": 0.37}
],
"topology": "self-biased wide-swing NMOS cascode mirror (Sooch, series-R bias)",
"rationale": "The 1:4 ratio comes from m=4 copies of the M1/M3 unit cells. The resistor R in the input branch sets the cascode gate to Vgs1 + Iin*R, which holds Vds1 = Vds2 near 0.2 V in every corner. With matched Vds the error is systematic only, about 0.2%. Rout is roughly gm4*ro4*ro2, which is in the MΩ range. Compliance is about Vds2 + ~0.1 V, roughly 0.3 V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # bottom mirror devices M1/M2
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid3": (17.0, 10.0, 22.0),    # cascode devices M3/M4 (low Vdsat)
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "vds1":  (0.20, 0.15, 0.26),    # target Vds of the bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", 80e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    k = int(round(iout / iin))

    # Bottom mirror unit (M1 = input) and output (M2 = k copies of the unit)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iin, vds=p["vds1"])
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iin * k, vds=p["vds1"])

    # Input cascode M3: source sits at vds1, drain sits at node B = Vgs1
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - p["vds1"], 0.1)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], iin, vds=vds3, vsb=p["vds1"])
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], iin * k,
                  vds=max(vout - p["vds1"], 0.1), vsb=p["vds1"])

    # Series resistor: V(iin) = Vgs1 + Iin*R = Vgs3 + vds1
    vr = p["vds1"] + m3.vgs - m1.vgs
    vr = max(vr, 0.05)
    R = vr / iin

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # Input branch: iin -> R -> B (gate of M1/M2, drain of M3)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "nb", R)
    n.dev("M3", "nb", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # Output branch
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m4, m=k)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", m2, m=k)

    # Predictions
    gds2 = m2.gds
    gm4, gds4 = m4.gm, m4.gds
    rout = (1.0 / gds4) * (1.0 + (gm4 + m4.gmbs) / gds2) + 1.0 / gds2
    # Residual Vds mismatch of M1 vs M2 through the cascode's finite gain
    dvx = (vout - m1.vgs) * gds4 / (gm4 + m4.gmbs + 1e-12)
    err = 100.0 * dvx * gds2 / (iout + 1e-15)
    v_comp = p["vds1"] + 0.6 * m4.vdsat
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": abs(err) + 0.2,
               "rout": rout,
               "v_compliance": v_comp,
               "power": 0.0}
```
